finding.headline: "The Rash-from-Wrong-Diaper"
finding.problem: "Which diaper won't give him a rash? The cheap one or the imported one? I can't afford to trial-and-error a whole pack. Help me choose one and buy in the right size."
finding.person: Mum facing 20 diaper brands in a Lagos supermarket (Molfix, Huggies, KissKids…) at different prices, scared of rashes and waste.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module / Bonus (brand-sizing cheat sheet).". Verdict: PASSES (4/5).
